data.name: PRSI
data.detailed_description:
Seeking escape from life's vicious cycle in a Czech pub, where cards, beer, and crude humor reveal the mysteries of Czech cultural heritage. Play cards, immerse yourself in pub atmosphere, and embark on a journey of self-reflection in a game that captures the essence of Czech culture while holding up a mirror to society's relationship with alcohol. Each new game, each fresh pint reveals new clues, memories, and stories that bring you closer to understanding not only the mysterious disappearance, but also Czech pub culture and its darker sides.

How is Prší played?

In Prší, you embark on a surrealistic detective investigation into the strange disappearance of a regular patron, leaving behind nothing but a sweaty half-pint of beer. The investigation unfolds through the card game Prší - to continue dialogue, you must play a card.

In the pub, you'll meet six characters, each holding memories of the missing Franta. Their stories and your choices in conversations gradually piece together a picture of who Franta was and what might have happened to him. Each character plays Prší slightly differently, reflecting their personalities and relationship with the game.

The game lasts approximately one hour but offers replayability with different choices that reveal new aspects of the story and characters. Different playthroughs show how your understanding of Franta's personality changes depending on how you conduct your investigation.

Cultural Commentary

Czechia is the lead producer and also lead drinker of this golden juice. Czechs drink approximately 128 liters of Beer per Person a Year (based on 2025 statistics). We have a drinking problem and we should talk about it. The game balances social critique with elements of magical realism, drawing inspiration from works like Jan Werich's Fimfárum. Czech beer culture was added to the national heritage list in January 2025. Czechia included beer culture among its intangible heritage, paving the way for UNESCO candidacy - Prague, Czech Republic. It celebrates the tradition where Czechs consume more beer per capita than anywhere else in the world, while this source of national pride also might overlook the normalization of alcoholism and other socially problematic issues related to beer consumption and alcoholism.

Game Features

  • 1 hour (ish) gameplay combining card strategy with detective work

  • Unique card-dialogue system where PRŠÍ determines conversation flow

  • Multiple story paths shaped by your playing style and decisions

  • Social commentary woven through surrealistic storytelling

  • 6 distinct characters with individual playing styles and hidden depths of narrative

What is PRŠÍ card game?

PRŠÍ (PRSHEE [prʃɪː]) is a well-known Czech Card game that found its way into the local pub culture.

What is Herdek?

Herdek is a 5-person collective of artists based in Prague, Czechia. Our goal is to create small games that blend unconventional gameplay with social criticism.

Awards and Recognition

Prší has won the Jury Award at FinalFinal vol3 in Prague and has been nominated for Digital Moment Award at AMAZE Berlin 2025 and Best Student Project at Games 4 Change 2025.
Thank you <3

data.short_description: A short detective-card-adventure set in a dirty Czech pub. Play cards, get wasted and embark on a journey of self-reflection.

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700HQ or AMD FX-8350, 4.2 GHz

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K, 3.6 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660, 6 GB or Radeon RX 580, 4 GB
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: We are going through the themes of alcoholism and how is it connected to Czech culture. The theme is presented mainly on how it affects life of one individual and how his relationship to alcohol shapes their reality.
